results.question: Show FIR cases registered in Bengaluru Urban district in the last 6 months
results.generated_sql:
SELECT cm."CaseMasterID", d."DistrictName", cm."CrimeNo", cm."CrimeRegisteredDate", ch."CrimeGroupName", csh."CrimeHeadName", cs."CaseStatusName"
FROM "CaseMaster" cm
JOIN "Unit" u ON u."UnitID" = cm."PoliceStationID"
JOIN "District" d ON d."DistrictID" = u."DistrictID"
JOIN "CaseCategory" cc ON cc."CaseCategoryID" = cm."CaseCategoryID"
JOIN "CrimeHead" ch ON ch."CrimeHeadID" = cm."CrimeMajorHeadID"
JOIN "CrimeSubHead" csh ON csh."CrimeSubHeadID" = cm."CrimeMinorHeadID"
JOIN "CaseStatusMaster" cs ON cs."CaseStatusID" = cm."CaseStatusID"
WHERE cc."LookupValue" = 'FIR'
  AND d."DistrictName" = 'Bengaluru Urban'
  AND cm."CrimeRegisteredDate" >= DATE_TRUNC('month', NOW()) - INTERVAL '6 months'
ORDER BY cm."CrimeRegisteredDate" DESC
LIMIT 200

results.question: Which districts have the most Crimes Against Property this year?
results.generated_sql:
SELECT d."DistrictName", COUNT(*) AS property_crime_count
FROM "CaseMaster" cm
JOIN "CrimeHead" ch ON ch."CrimeHeadID" = cm."CrimeMajorHeadID"
JOIN "Unit" u ON u."UnitID" = cm."PoliceStationID"
JOIN "District" d ON d."DistrictID" = u."DistrictID"
WHERE ch."CrimeGroupName" = 'Crimes Against Property'
  AND cm."CrimeRegisteredDate" >= DATE_TRUNC('year', NOW())

ORDER BY property_crime_count DESC LIMIT 500

results.question: Which districts have rising crime this month compared to last month?
results.generated_sql:
SELECT d."DistrictName", COUNT(CASE WHEN cm."CrimeRegisteredDate" >= DATE_TRUNC('month', NOW()) THEN 1 END) AS current_month_cases, COUNT(CASE WHEN cm."CrimeRegisteredDate" >= DATE_TRUNC('month', NOW()) - INTERVAL '1 month' AND cm."CrimeRegisteredDate" < DATE_TRUNC('month', NOW()) THEN 1 END) AS previous_month_cases
FROM "CaseMaster" cm
JOIN "Unit" u ON u."UnitID" = cm."PoliceStationID"
JOIN "District" d ON d."DistrictID" = u."DistrictID"
WHERE cm."CrimeRegisteredDate" >= DATE_TRUNC('month', NOW()) - INTERVAL '1 month'
GROUP BY d."DistrictName"
HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN cm."CrimeRegisteredDate" >= DATE_TRUNC('month', NOW()) THEN 1 END) > COUNT(CASE WHEN cm."CrimeRegisteredDate" >= DATE_TRUNC('month', NOW()) - INTERVAL '1 month' AND cm."CrimeRegisteredDate" < DATE_TRUNC('month', NOW()) THEN 1 END)
ORDER BY current_month_cases DESC LIMIT 500
